text: well no thats whats fucking annoying is allegedally what we got was a faithful clone of the block bench behavior (which is not a fkn nightmare mind you) and evidently its far from it. very far from it. and if its the industry standard, that makes it more embarassing because i never at any point had any opinion that said this is better, thats agent big brain thinking
resolution: Part of the UV-confetti diagnosis thread that led to the unfold-chart build (see req_3876, commit a85590308). This message narrowed the root cause: the 'faithful Blockbench clone' claim was never parity-tested (Blockbench box UV unfolds a cuboid into one connected cross; ours made 6 islands), and the user's 'what else is a UV if not an unwrap' verdict became the pinned law — the cube-to-cross test now enforces it.
